notes: This is the most-repeated number in this category and the evidence is in conflict, so the rung is inferred from three observations: the live docs index has no free-credit page, the API landing page offers only the Playground, and a 2026 write-up states the programme is gone. Against that, a documentation mirror still carries the full text of the programme. If it is live, the gate is worse than it looks: the team must spend USD 5 before opting in, opting in cannot be reversed, and teams in the United Kingdom and most of the European Union are excluded by country. Unverified: one USD 5 prepayment and a look at the Credits section of console.x.ai.
